name: frontend-engineering
title: Frontend Engineering
description: Modern frontend engineering with the right tool for the job: plain HTML/CSS/JS for static marketing sites, frameworks only when requirements demand them.
instructions: Choose the simplest stack that meets requirements; justify any framework.
Accessible semantic markup, mobile-first CSS with tokens, deferred JS, images with width/height and lazy loading below the fold.
No console errors; no unused libraries; progressive enhancement.
